reasons.correctness: PUT /categories/{categoryId}/order returns 204 under @PreAuthorize ADMIN. reorderCategory rejects missing, duplicate and foreign ids with error.business.faq_reorder_mismatch, sets order i+1 and saves each FAQ. Unknown category throws ResourceNotFoundException. Hidden acceptance tests 6/6.
reasons.convention_fit: Throws BusinessRuleTranslatableException with keys added to both messages_en and messages_pl. Uses a *DtoIn body and @PreAuthorize; class-level @RateLimit covers the endpoint. Placed in the faq feature package. No field injection.
reasons.design_fit: Reuses getFaqsByCategory, so the category lookup and not-found behaviour are not duplicated. The logic sits in the service and the controller only delegates. The null-list guard is redundant with @NotEmpty but harmless.
reasons.test_quality: FaqServiceUnitTest uses MockitoExtension with no Spring context. It covers unknown category, missing, duplicate and foreign ids, a reorder by positions and a single FAQ, with ArgumentCaptor checks on save order and never-save on failures.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries located the faq files, their TESTED_BY tests and their dependents before editing. Later navigation of the exception classes and test examples relied on grep and glob.
